scientific_integrity: The all-integer monotonicity and uniform asymptotic remainder are analytic results; numerical checks support, but do not establish, the all-parameter conclusions or scientific priority. The conditional protocol, Bessel walk, and generic Legendre asymptotic calculus are prior work.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric infinite nearest-neighbour lattice, independent exponentially distributed reset intervals, two equally distant integer reset sites, origin ties broken fairly, correlations indexed by reset count; no physical-time autocorrelation or arbitrary-geometry claim.
title: A monotone finite-separation law for hidden memory in conditional quantum resetting
